skill.name: decision-makers-at-company
skill.description: Turns one company domain into a ranked list of the people most likely to buy what you sell. Uses enrich_company to size and classify the account, then search_people filtered to that domain, and ranks each person by role in the deal with match reasons and email status. Use when someone asks "who should I talk to at this company", "find the decision-makers at stackfold.io" or "map the buyers at this account".
skill.summary: Rank likely buyers, champions, and influencers at one company using Leadsets and your product description.
skill.author: leadsets

security_audit.summary: The shell execution, environment access, and system reconnaissance alerts are false positives. The workflow sends the target domain and search filters to Leadsets, and its instructions conflict on email verification and credit limits. No evidence found of credential theft, host reconnaissance, or prompt injection.

remediation.suggestion: Before the first lookup, disclose that Leadsets receives the target domain and derived filters. Keep API keys in an approved credential store.
Label search-only email statuses as unconfirmed. Display a verified status only with separate verification evidence and a timestamp. Do not imply permission to send.

remediation.issue: Quota check can understate planned usage
remediation.suggestion: Include the probe and planned search in the initial estimate. Cap each page to the remaining allowance and stop if the next call exceeds it.

semantic_findings.title: Conflicting Email Verification Rules
semantic_findings.description: The skill requires separate verification, yet it tells users that emails labeled verified are ready to send without performing that check. Users may rely on unconfirmed contact data.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The text requires a verification tool result but also tells the agent to show search statuses as returned. Neither verification tool runs in this workflow.

semantic_findings.title: Quota Check Understates Planned Search
semantic_findings.description: The initial check budgets for the target count plus one probe, but the main search requests about 1.5 times the target. Extra results can consume more credits than the initial check accounts for.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The initial threshold and main request size differ, and each returned record costs one credit. The final quota rule does not specify a cap before the larger request.

content.value_statement: Job titles alone do not tell you who might approve or support a purchase. Use Leadsets to rank likely buyers at one company and explain why each contact fits.
actual_capabilities: Looks up a company's name, industry, and employee count range from its domain.
Checks Leadsets usage and tests the search filters with a single record.
Filters contacts by company domain, job function, and seniority.
Ranks likely budget owners, champions, and influencers and explains why each contact fits.
Shows available email addresses and their reported status without inventing missing details.
Returns a chat table or CSV and can update HubSpot contacts through an existing connection after confirmation.
limitations: Requires a Leadsets account and either its MCP connection or an API key. Lookups use the account's available records.
Searches one domain at a time and returns up to 25 contacts.
Deal roles are estimates based on available data, not proof of purchasing authority.
Does not verify email addresses again or send outreach.

prompt_templates.title: Find Likely Buyers
prompt_templates.prompt: Find likely buyers at [company domain] for [product and buying team]. Show the results in chat.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with one company and a product description.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Shortlist
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to five decision-makers at [company domain] for [product]. Explain each rank and report any missing deal role.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a focused list for account planning.

prompt_templates.title: Export Contacts for Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to ten contacts at [company domain] for [product and buying team]. Export a CSV and flag missing or unconfirmed email statuses.
prompt_templates.scenario: Review the results in a spreadsheet.

prompt_templates.title: Review Before a CRM Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Rank up to 15 contacts at [company domain] for [product and buying team]. Show the results and missing deal roles. Ask me to confirm the HubSpot company before writing any contacts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Review the contacts and destination before changing the CRM.

best_practices: Provide the exact company domain and describe the team that buys your product.
Check that your available Leadsets credits cover the probe and planned search before proceeding.
Review contact and email statuses before use, and confirm the destination before allowing a CRM update.
anti_patterns: Providing several company domains in one request.
Treating a likely deal role as confirmed purchasing authority.
Treating a search listing or a catch-all address as proof of email verification.

faq.question: What do I need to get started?
faq.answer: Provide one company domain and a short product or buying-team description. Connect Leadsets through MCP or configure its API key.

faq.question: How many contacts can I request?
faq.answer: The default is 10 contacts and the maximum is 25 per company. The search may return fewer if there are not enough matches.

faq.question: How are contacts ranked?
faq.answer: The skill ranks by inferred deal role, then seniority, title fit, and reported email status.

faq.question: Does the skill verify emails or send messages?
faq.answer: No. It shows available email statuses but does not run a fresh verification or send messages.

faq.question: What if the search finds no budget owner?
faq.answer: The report says that no budget owner was found. It does not assign that role just to fill a gap.

faq.question: Where can I put the results?
faq.answer: Chat is the default, and CSV is optional. HubSpot updates require a connected account and confirmation of the destination.
